topic: Dry winter eyes: indoor heat, screens and eye drop options
headline: Soothe dry
intro: Indoor heat, cold wind and screens can leave eyes dry. We can help you pick the right eye drops.

points.title: Try the 20-20-20 rule
points.body: Every 20 minutes of screen time, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

points.title: Pick your drop type
points.body: Lubricating drops, gels and night ointments feel different. Read the label and ask us which fits.
points.tip: Single-use vials are handy on the go.

points.title: Add moisture at home
points.body: Heated indoor air is dry. A humidifier and sipping water through the day can help you stay comfortable.

points.title: Know when to get checked
points.body: Eye pain, vision changes or redness that won't go away? See a doctor or optometrist promptly.
points.tip: Wear contacts? Ask us which drops fit.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.

caption_instagram:
4 ways to soothe dry winter eyes 👀❄️

Looking for dry eye relief in North York or a Toronto pharmacy near Yorkdale? Indoor heating, cold wind and long screen days can leave eyes feeling dry and gritty. Try the 20-20-20 rule, add moisture at home with a humidifier, shield your eyes from the wind, and pick the eye drop type that fits: lubricating drops, gels or a nighttime ointment. Eye pain, vision changes or redness that won't go away? See a doctor or optometrist promptly.

Our North York pharmacy carries lubricating eye drops, single-use vials, eye gels and night ointments, and we're happy to help you choose.
